items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: the only attraction they had was Eko and Iko. They were two albinos that when one would say one thing, the other would repeat.

ctx.x: What was this gentleman Mancy like?

Manzie Campbell was the only man that I have ever seen or met, or anybody ever met in the world, that could take his left hand and play a perfect drum roll. The show that he was on - I had met him - was a silent screen show. You must remember in those days when P. G. Lowry was playing the side show - this was before the Ubangi tribe because the only attraction they had was Eko and Iko. They were two albinos that when one would say one thing, the other would repeat. "How's the weather today?" "How's the weather…
Meanwhile there was a black man that looked exactly like Jack Johnson. He was from Oklahoma. His name was Crack Johnson. Crack Johnson played in the big tent with John Philip Sousa.
